citeAs: Agirre, Banea, Cardie, Cer, Diab, Gonzalez-Agirre, Guo, Mihalcea, Rigau, and Wiebe (2022). SemEval-2022 Task 8: Multilingual News Article Similarity. SemEval 2022.
creator: Eneko Agirre, Carmen Banea, Claire Cardie, Daniel Cer, Mona Diab, Aitor Gonzalez-Agirre, Weiwei Guo, Rada Mihalcea, German Rigau, Janyce Wiebe (SemEval)
description: STS22 is a cross-lingual semantic textual similarity dataset included in MTEB. It contains sentence pairs in different languages where the goal is to assess their similarity using continuous scores from 0 to 5.
name: STS22
rai:dataCollection: The dataset contains crosslingual pairs of sentences for semantic textual similarity. In MTEB, STS22 is included as one of the STS tasks and contains 18 language pairs among Arabic, English, French, German, Turkish, Spanish, Polish, Italian, Russian and Chinese.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentence pairs in different languages drawn for semantic textual similarity evaluation.
rai:dataLimitations: MTEB notes that multilingual coverage is limited across tasks; STS is multilingual, but other task types such as retrieval and clustering are English-only in the benchmark.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating text embedding models on cross-lingual semantic textual similarity tasks.
